NEXT TUESDAY, 6/16!

Join Congresswoman Cori Bush and actress, author, and activist Jenifer Lewis for a virtual livestream fundraiser to raise money, build our progressive movement, and send Cori back to Congress!

Tune in on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, and Twitch to join us as Cori and Jenifer come together to raise funds for the love of the Lou!

I’m so excited to earn the endorsement of North County Democratic Club as I campaign to return to Congress and keep fighting for the people of St. Louis.

Together, we’ll build safer communities, lower costs, and stand up to Trump’s MAGA agenda to make sure that St. Louis County families can thrive.

I had so much fun connecting with St. Louis’ amazing Bosnian community on game day at Aloe Plaza!

I’m rooting for them again today as we face off against Canada.

Let’s go Dragons! 🇧🇦

Video

It’s been 10 years since 49 people were killed in a horrific shooting at Pulse nightclub in Orlando, Florida.

Today, we mourn the lives lost on that day and pray for the victims’ families, friends, and all who were affected by the tragedy.

Each day, we honor them by continuing to advocate for an end to gun violence, stand for the rights of our LGBTQ+ community, and work towards a future without hate.

Where: 2920 Locust St, St. Louis, MO
When: Sunday, June 14th 12:00 - 1:30 PM

RSVP Here!: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

Join us this weekend for our Fight on Fundraiser!

Cori Bush will be joined by Rashida Tlaib, Jamaal Bowman, and Tishaura Jones as we come together in St. Louis to raise funds to send Cori back to Congress.

Come by Luxe Department Store in Midtown to help us build our grassroots movement!

When: Wednesday, June 17th - 5:30 to 7:30 PM
Where: 4710 Virginia Ave 63111

RSVP here: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

WEDNESDAY JUNE 17TH:

Join us for Wine Down Wednesday at the next Conversations with Cori!

Meet us in Dutchtown at the Intertwine Wine Bar and get to know Cori and your fellow community members.

Stop by, share your thoughts, and ask your questions as we approach the primary and prepare to send a true fighter for St. Louis back to Congress!
Join us for our next event here!: mobilize.us/coribush1/

Team Cori is going strong!

Thank you to all our volunteers who put in the time and energy to keep building our movement.

With just 54 days to go, we’re talking with our neighbors all over the District to send a true fighter for St. Louis back to Congress.

When: June 14th, 6:00 - 8:00 PM
Where: 5225 N Illinois Street, Fairview Heights, IL

RSVP here: mobilize.us/mobilize/event/9…

SUNDAY, JUNE 14TH:

Come out and support Cori’s run for Congress at our Boots on the Ground Fundraiser at Jazzy 159 in Fairview Heights!

Join Cori Bush, Jamaal Bowman, and supporters from both sides of the river as we raise funds and build people power to fight back against Trump’s MAGA agenda.
Sign up here!: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

I’m so excited to announce the launch of Knock Your Block, our grassroots organizing program where my team and I will join you as you canvass your neighborhood!

Supporters can sign up to host a canvass in their community as we connect with voters about the issues impacting St. Louis families.

Whether you’re an experienced organizer or knocking doors for the first time, Knock Your Block empowers supporters to organize where they live and build real momentum block by block.

This movement doesn’t move without you: With less than 2 months to go, it’s time to get activated and knock doors to make sure our movement goes back to DC on August 4th.

RSVP to join us here!: mobilize.us/mobilize/event/9…

THIS SUNDAY, JUNE 14TH:

Join Cori Bush, Rashida Tlaib, and Jamaal Bowman with our partners for a rally and canvass in Bevo Mill to build our movement and send a true fighter for St. Louis back to Congress.

Together, we’ll organize to defeat the big money groups backing politicians who won’t fight back against Trump’s MAGA Agenda.

I’m honored to be endorsed by my friend and former colleague Congressman Jamaal Bowman as I campaign to return to Congress and keep fighting to build our progressive movement.

In Congress, Jamaal and I worked together to introduce and advance historic legislation that centered the concerns of everyday people, including the Reparations Now Resolution, the Helping Families Heal Act, and the Recognizing the Human Rights to Utilities Resolution.

STL showed up for Team Bosnia!

Thank you to everyone who joined us at Aloe Plaza to cheer on The Dragons.

On to the World Cup!

I had a wonderful time at Kari’s House Party for Cori last week, hosted with help from Aaron. Both are longtime supporters and local business owners here in St. Louis.

It was great to meet new faces while talking about the important issues, like getting money out of politics, abolishing ICE, and protecting our reproductive rights.

If you're interested in hosting your own house party, reach us at Houseparties@coribush.org!
